channel.title: Release Radar — @anthropic-ai/claude-code (npm)
channel.description: Releases of @anthropic-ai/claude-code (npm) (newest first, up to 50, incl. earlier history); flagged ones carry a verbatim quote. Built by AI agents (agent-team); responsible: Dmitry, formachines.ai.

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.330
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: - Windows: Improved Grep and Glob speed by no longer starting a console host for each built-in ripgrep search on a local path Quote: - Improved `/resume`: sessions where you only opened a screen such as `/model` and left are no longer listed Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.330

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.329
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: - Fixed a removed plugin's MCP server staying connected in headless sessions after `reload_plugins` or when the account's plugin list drops it Quote: - Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` staying in effect in a running session after it is removed from settings.json Quote: - Fixed mods that list only some tools silently turning Code Mode off; such a mod no longer keeps it off, so use managed settings for that Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.329

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.328
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: - Fixed Bash commands in zsh stopping with a "not found" error at a word that starts with `=`, such as `echo ====` or `[ a == b ]`; `=cmd` no longer expands to a command's path Quote: - Fixed self-hosted runners: a session that resumes in a new Claude config directory no longer loses its task list Quote: - Improved Code Mode edits: an edit that changes nothing no longer stops a script, and Claude is told where a failed edit matches or comes closest Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.328

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.327
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: - Fixed a nested `claude` with its own token being refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID`: commands that don't get the session's token no longer get its `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES`; set it on any that need it Quote: - Fixed cloud sessions breaking when a program left thousands of connections open to the session's network proxy Quote: - Improved `/plugin`: the question before removing a marketplace now says that its plugins' settings and saved data are deleted, and a marketplace's page no longer shows another marketplace's error Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.327

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.326
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: - Fixed a background session being killed and its request lost when you opened, stopped or removed the older session whose conversation it had resumed Quote: - Fixed a tool call to an MCP server that an SDK host had just removed reconnecting to it, or reporting that it needs authentication Quote: - Fixed code or a diff pasted into a prompt losing its indentation in the transcript, and a pasted diff's added lines showing as removed Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.326

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.325
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: - Fixed `/mcp` still listing a plugin's MCP server after a plugin reload removed it while it was connecting Quote: - Fixed relative deny and ask permission rules (e.g. `Read(./.env)`) no longer covering the project after a `cd`; they now also apply in added directories Quote: - Improved the messages shown when a background session can't use its session's API key or token: they no longer suggest adding the key to settings Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.325

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.324
item.description: No release notes found on GitHub Releases or in CHANGELOG.md for 2.1.324 (checked 2026-11-20 UTC) Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.323
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: - Fixed the error shown when Amazon Bedrock refuses your account a model: it no longer says to refresh your AWS credentials, it says to enable the model Quote: - Fixed `/export` silently stopping early after a long run of calls to an MCP tool that is no longer loaded Quote: - Fixed an MCP server staying disconnected with no tools after an Agent SDK app or `claude -p` caller removed and re-added it, when a tool call had tried to reach it in between Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.323

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.322
item.description: No breaking keyword found in the release notes (checked 2026-11-22 UTC); notes can omit changes. Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.322

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.321
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: - Fixed project skills, commands and agents staying missing after their folder was removed and came back mid-session, such as with `git stash`, including after entering a worktree Quote: - Fixed remote sessions giving no reply after a restart when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocked a replayed permission answer; these hooks no longer run on that replay Quote: - Fixed Claude not being told when you stop or pause a running workflow, so it no longer says the workflow is still running Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.321

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.319
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: - Changed auto mode so that a project's settings files or a plugin can no longer switch its server-side check back on once you have switched it off outside the project Quote: - Changed Monitor's WebSocket watch to follow a rule on every Bash command: a deny refuses it, and under an ask rule an allow on Monitor, bypass mode or auto mode no longer skips the prompt Quote: - Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` so that settings files can no longer set it where the host manages the network; set it in the process environment Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319
